'''M8T-V''' was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] posted on the [[Carrick Station]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. In [[3643 BBY]] it delivered to Republic personnel a [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] message from [[Satele Shan]] who asked the Republic heroes to participate in a dangerous [[Colicoid/Legends|Colicoid]] wargame in order to acquire new weapons for the Republic.
